description: Measure and improve test-suite strength with mutation testing: pick a tool (mutmut or cosmic-ray for Python, cargo-mutants for Rust, Stryker for JS/TS, PIT for Java), scope runs to changed code, interpret killed/survived/timeout/no-coverage mutants, recognize equivalent mutants, write the missing assertions, and set sensible score gates in CI. Use when line coverage is high but you doubt the assertions, when reviewing a test suite's quality for critical logic, or when adding a quality gate for new code. Do NOT use for writing first tests (unit-testing, test-driven-development), exploring input space (property-based-testing, fuzz-testing), or whole-repo runs on slow suites without scoping.
